content.title: Appendix A — Licensing & Pricing
content.content:
**Key Requirement: Perpetual License Option**

The RFP explicitly requires a perpetual license option alongside any subscription pricing. This is non-negotiable for Airbus. Pricing must include both models clearly labelled.

**Pricing Structure to Include:**

- **Option A — Perpetual License**: One-time license fee + annual maintenance & support (typically 20–25% of license). Broken down by component (Ground Plex nodes, Manager)
- **Option B — Annual Subscription**: Per-year SaaS/subscription pricing. Include multi-year discount tiers (3-year, 5-year)
- **Professional Services**: Implementation services (T&M or fixed-deliverable), training, managed services
- **Training**: Developer Essentials, Citizen Developer workshops, SnapLogic University access

[BOX:warning]
**TO FILL: ACTUAL PRICING FIGURES**

Sean (AE) to populate with actual commercial terms. Do not include in content draft — confidential. Compile directly in Word document.
[/BOX]

**Licensing Notes:**

- **Base SKU — core pricing**: Ground Plex capacity-based pricing
- **Prof. Services — PS pricing**: Standard daily rates for EMEA consultants
- **Legal — commercial terms review**: Review perpetual license terms with Legal before submission

**Additional Notes:**

- License is NOT per-pipeline, per-user, or per-record — it's capacity-based (Ground Plex node count or processing throughput)
- Perpetual license includes product updates and patches for the maintenance period
- Support SLA options: Standard (business hours), Premium (24x7, 1-hour response for P1 incidents)
